errors.evidence: The reference and image show the training set bars as dark blue, not light blue ('浅蓝色').
The reference and image show the validation set bars as standard orange, not light orange ('浅橙色').

The reference explicitly states the chart presents the distribution of training set quantity, validation set quantity, and accuracy for different recognition and reasoning tasks. The machine-generated description omits this specific purpose, only broadly mentioning 'five different natural language processing tasks'.
The reference mentions the logical order of categories on the horizontal axis, while the machine-generated description only states the order without noting it as logical or meaningful.

errors.text_span: 图表主体由分组柱状图和一条折线图组成。根据顶部图例，浅蓝色柱状图代表“训练集数量”，浅橙色柱状图代表“验证集数量”，灰色折线代表“准确率”。在每个任务类别上，浅蓝色和浅橙色的柱状图并排分组垂直排列，且柱体和折线节点的确切数值均注释标注在相应位置的周边。
